dis.definitions.fixture.fx001: Six source cells add up to 420 million; the CTMTQG of 40 million is part of a cell and is not added.
dis.definitions.fixture.fx002: The cumulative of week 40 is 150 million, not 250 million of two weeks added; the change is 50 million.
dis.definitions.fixture.fx003: The rate of a unit is the sum of the numerators over the sum of the denominators: 50/100 and 90/900 million are 14%, not the mean of 50% and 10%.
dis.definitions.fixture.fx004: One numerator of 600 million is 60% of the plan of 1 billion given by the Prime Minister and 48% of the plan of 1.25 billion with the local addition.
dis.definitions.fixture.fx005: With the Treasury cutoff on 30 September the 500 million paid that day counts and the 300 million paid on 1 October does not.
dis.definitions.fixture.fx006: A CTMTQG of 120 million inside a cell of 100 million is refused: the subset cannot pass its parent.
dis.definitions.fixture.fx007: Three units ranked by rate, a tie goes to the larger disbursement, and the unit below the minimum plan is left out with its reason.
